# traytail v0.1.0

First release. A minimal Tailscale tray icon for Wayland bars that host the
[StatusNotifierItem](https://www.freedesktop.org/wiki/Specifications/status-notifier-item/)
protocol — built and tested against [ashell](https://github.com/MalpenZibo/ashell).

No GUI toolkit: pure Go, one dependency (`github.com/godbus/dbus/v5`), no asset files.

## Highlights

- **Status icon** with four states: connected (filled), offline (hollow), exit node in use (green ring), login required / captive portal (amber)
- **Exit nodes** with a usable UI:
  - Full city/country labels from the tailnet's own `Location` data (no hostname hunting)
  - Active country hoisted to the top of the Mullvad list, `●`/`○` radio markers everywhere, explicit `Off` entry
  - Active nodes matched by Tailscale IP (rename-proof)
- **Smart auto** (replaces native `auto:any`): away from home → own exit node, at home → last-used Mullvad node (persisted across restarts). Re-applies on reconnect and profile switch; manual picks always win
- **Captive portal handling**: reads NetworkManager over DBus (no `nmcli` shell-outs), disconnects tailscale when a Wi-Fi portal hijacks the network, opens the discovered login page in chromium, and reconnects once the portal clears — with minute-level fresh checks, flap protection, and a gateway-fallback login URL
- **Multiple profiles**: switch accounts from the tray; works while disconnected (switch = switch + connect)
- Deselect the own exit node with one click → applies the last-used Mullvad node

## Install

```sh
sudo make install            # build + install to /usr/local/bin
# or without root:
make install PREFIX=$HOME/.local
```

Requirements: Go ≥ 1.24, `tailscale` CLI in `$PATH`, `tailscaled` running, `sudo tailscale set --operator=$USER` once.

## Notes

- Works with any SNI host (ashell, waybar, KDE Plasma) — ashell is the reference and tested host
- For full portal-detection capability, NetworkManager's connectivity check should be enabled (some distros ship it off) and the binary benefits from `cap_net_admin` (granted by `sudo make install`) so probes can bypass an active tailscale tunnel

## Quality

- Unit + DBus integration tests, run with `-race` in CI; ~90% statement coverage
